records.source: Ooh!... I can read it on your face. You're going to love it here in Pelican Town.#$b#If you're ever looking for something to do in the evening, stop by the saloon. That's where I work!
records.translation: Ooh!... Nakikita ko sa mukha mo. Magugustuhan mo rito sa Bayan ng Pelican.#$b#Kung naghahanap ka ng magagawa sa gabi, dumaan ka sa saloon. Doon ako nagtatrabaho!

records.source: Oh, you remembered my birthday! Thanks, @! That's really nice of you.$h
records.translation: Oh, naalala mo ang kaarawan ko! Salamat, @! Napakabait mo.$h

records.source: Oh, you remembered my birthday! Thanks, @! That's really ni--$h#$b#...*sniff*...*sniff*... what is that smell?$s#$b#... What is this...?$s
records.translation: Oh, naalala mo ang kaarawan ko! Salamat, @! Napakabai--$h#$b#...*Singhot*...*Singhot*... ano ang amoy na iyon?$s#$b#... Ano ito...?$s

records.source: Yes, I'd love to dance with you, @!$h#$e#Now I'm excited... This is going to be a lot of fun!
records.translation: Oo, gustung-gusto kong makipagsayaw sa iyo, @!$h#$e#Nasasabik na ako... Magiging napakasaya nito!

records.source: Wow, thank you! I've heard that if you drink this before bed you'll have vivid dreams.
records.translation: Wow, salamat! Narinig kong magkakaroon ka ng mga napakalinaw na panaginip kung iinumin mo ito bago matulog.

records.source: Oh, good, it's still warm... Poor thing, where's it's mother? *Whisper* ...I'll be your mother, don't worry... Poor baby.$s#$b#I'm glad you gave this to me, @. I'll take very good care of it.
records.translation: Oh, mabuti, mainit-init pa ito... Kawawa naman, nasaan ang nanay nito? *Bulong* ...Ako na ang magiging nanay mo, huwag kang mag-alala... Kawawang munting sanggol.$s#$b#Natutuwa akong ibinigay mo ito sa akin, @. Aalagaan ko itong mabuti.

records.source: $c 0.5#Oh, wow... Thank you! This color perfectly captures my mood today.$h#The warm, soothing energy of this stone helps us re-center our thoughts... It's actually just what I needed on a day like this. Thanks!
records.translation: $c 0.5#Oh, wow... Salamat! Ganap na nakukuha ng kulay na ito ang damdamin ko ngayon.$h#Tinutulungan tayo ng mainit at nakagiginhawang enerhiya ng batong ito na muling ituon ang mga kaisipan natin... Ito talaga mismo ang kailangan ko sa araw na tulad nito. Salamat!

records.source: $c 0.5#That's funny, I had a dream that you would give me a piece of jade today!$h#Ooh, it's jade! This is supposed to attract wealth... And who couldn't do with a few extra coins in the pocket?$h
records.translation: $c 0.5#Nakakatawa, nanaginip akong bibigyan mo ako ng isang piraso ng jade ngayon!$h#Ooh, jade ito! Sinasabing umaakit ito ng kayamanan... At sino ba ang aayaw sa ilang dagdag na baryang nasa bulsa?$h

records.source: $c 0.5#Oh, it's beautiful, @! I hope you didn't put yourself in too much danger to get this.$h#Ah, an amethyst! This will protect me on those late nights working at the Saloon.
records.translation: $c 0.5#Oh, napakaganda nito, @! Sana ay hindi mo isinapanganib nang husto ang sarili mo upang makuha ito.$h#Ah, isang ametista! Poprotektahan ako nito sa mga gabing ginagabi ako sa pagtatrabaho sa Saloon.

records.source: $c 0.5#Wow, look at that color! It matches perfectly with my outfit.$h#Oh, this is perfect... I've been feeling a little sluggish lately. Rubies are great for energizing the spirit!
records.translation: $c 0.5#Wow, tingnan mo ang kulay na iyan! Bagay na bagay ito sa suot ko.$h#Oh, perpekto ito... Medyo matamlay ako nitong huli. Napakahusay ng mga rubi sa pagpapasigla ng espiritu!

records.source: $c 0.5#It's so smooth! When I hold it... I can feel the energy of all the mermaids in the sea. Thank you!#Thank you! I'm gonna put this under my pillow, and hopefully I'll dream about the ocean.
records.translation: $c 0.5#Napakakinis nito! Kapag hawak ko ito... nararamdaman ko ang enerhiya ng lahat ng sirena sa dagat. Salamat!#Salamat! Ilalagay ko ito sa ilalim ng unan ko, at sana ay mapanaginipan ko ang karagatan.

records.source: $c 0.5#Oh!... Heheh... I know exactly why you gave me this stone today. Very interesting...#Wow, it's beautiful! This color makes me think of all the spiritual power within the forest... Can you feel that wood energy?
records.translation: $c 0.5#Oh!... Heheh... Alam ko mismo kung bakit mo ibinigay sa akin ang batong ito ngayon. Lubhang kawili-wili...#Wow, napakaganda nito! Ipinapaalala sa akin ng kulay na ito ang lahat ng kapangyarihang espirituwal sa loob ng kagubatan... Nararamdaman mo ba ang enerhiya ng kahoy?

records.source: There must be a meaning behind this... Nature is trying to tell us something.$3#$e#What, though? I can't tell... It's hard to read. I feel a strong presence, though...$3
records.translation: Tiyak na may kahulugan ang lahat ng ito... May sinusubukang sabihin sa atin ang kalikasan.$3#$e#Pero ano? Hindi ko matukoy... Mahirap itong basahin. Gayunman, nakararamdam ako ng malakas na presensiya...$3

records.source: Can you feel it? The forest is singing! The trees are dancing with joy!
records.translation: Nararamdaman mo ba? Umaawit ang kagubatan! Sumasayaw sa tuwa ang mga puno!

records.source: That was a beautiful wedding... I'm really happy for you and Haley!$h
records.translation: Napakaganda ng kasal... Talagang masaya ako para sa inyo ni Haley!$h

records.source: Haley is too proud to be heartbroken over the divorce... Or at least to show it.$3
records.translation: Masyadong mapagmataas si Haley para amining nasaktan siya sa diborsiyo... O ipakita man lang iyon.$3

records.source: Hello @. I had a feeling I'd be seeing you today.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. May kutob akong makikita kita ngayon.

records.source: Nothing is more sad than an injured animal...$s
records.translation: Wala nang mas malungkot kaysa sa isang sugatang hayop...$s

records.source: Now that you have a sheep, you'll be able to make cloth! That'll open up a whole new world of tailoring possibilities. Just wait and see.
records.translation: Ngayong may tupa ka na, makagagawa ka na ng tela! Magbubukas iyon ng isang ganap na bagong mundo ng mga posibilidad sa pananahi. Hintayin mo lang at makikita mo.

records.source: Have you ever tried cooking without a recipe? It's kind of liberating.#$b#And who knows... you might discover something amazing!
records.translation: Nasubukan mo na bang magluto nang walang resipe? Parang nakapagpapalaya iyon.#$b#At sino ang nakaaalam... baka makatuklas ka ng isang kamangha-manghang bagay!

records.source: My outing with Clint was pretty fun!#$b#Although, he spilled a root beer all over himself within ten minutes of getting there, and then barely said a word the rest of the night.$3
records.translation: Masaya ang lakad namin ni Clint!#$b#Pero sa loob ng sampung minuto pagkarating namin, natapon niya sa sarili niya ang isang serbesang-ugat at halos hindi na nagsalita sa natitirang bahagi ng gabi.$3

records.source: Hey, I saw you at Sam's show. It was fun!$h#$e#The city smelled pretty bad, though.$s
records.translation: Hoy, nakita kita sa palabas ni Sam. Masaya iyon!$h#$e#Pero medyo mabaho ang lungsod.$s

records.source: I won't forget our camping trip any time soon...$l
records.translation: Hindi ko malilimutan sa madaling panahon ang pagkakamping natin...$l

records.source: %Emily has a big smile on her face.
records.translation: %Malaki ang ngiti sa mukha ni Emily.

records.source: We're going to have a lot of fun together, I just know it.$h
records.translation: Marami tayong masasayang gagawin nang magkasama, alam ko talaga.$h

records.source: Well, now that you're married, I assume Shane won't be coming to the Saloon as much!#$e#That's probably a good thing, but it's always a little sad to lose a regular...$s
records.translation: Aba, ngayong kasal na kayo, palagay ko'y hindi na gaanong madalas pumunta si Shane sa Saloon!#$e#Malamang ay mabuti iyon, pero laging medyo malungkot mawalan ng isang suki...$s

records.source: Oh, I like this place! It's full of parrots!
records.translation: Oh, gusto ko ang lugar na ito! Punô ito ng mga loro!

records.source: Ah... my lungs feel perfect.
records.translation: Ah... ang sarap huminga.

records.source: Can you feel it? The ocean has a profound healing energy.
records.translation: Nararamdaman mo ba? May malalim na enerhiyang nakapagpapagaling ang karagatan.

records.source: Are you having fun, @? You need to remember to take breaks now and then too!
records.translation: Nagsasaya ka ba, @? Kailangan mo ring tandaang magpahinga paminsan-minsan!

records.source: It's nice to be on this side of the bar for once!$h
records.translation: Masarap namang mapunta sa panig na ito ng bar kahit minsan!$h

records.source: If you open your heart to the sun, you can feel a loving energy inside of you.$h
records.translation: Kung bubuksan mo ang puso mo sa araw, mararamdaman mo ang mapagmahal na enerhiya sa loob mo.$h

records.source: %Emily is lost in the music.
records.translation: %Lubos na nahuhumaling si Emily sa musika.

records.source: Of course, my love. I've been looking forward to this!$h
records.translation: Siyempre, mahal ko. Inaasam ko ito!$h

records.source: I'm very sorry... but I've already agreed to dance with someone else.$u
records.translation: Ikinalulungkot ko talaga... pero pumayag na akong makipagsayaw sa iba.$u

records.source: @... You broke my heart... I just can't talk to you anymore.$s#$e#Please, let me try to heal...$s
records.translation: @... Winasak mo ang puso ko... Hindi na talaga kita kayang kausapin.$s#$e#Pakiusap, hayaan mo akong maghilom...$s

records.preserveReason: The value contains only an ellipsis and an emotion control token, with no translatable wording.

records.source: B...But I thought we had a special bond... *sniff*$s
records.translation: P...Pero akala ko ay may natatangi tayong ugnayan... *Singhot*$s

records.source: Oh, that's beautiful... I have a friend who would love that! But she lives far from here...
records.translation: Oh, napakaganda niyan... May kaibigan akong tiyak na magugustuhan iyan! Pero malayo siya rito...

records.source: @... I'm ready to give you a second chance. I still have faith that there's a good person inside of you.$s
records.translation: @... Handa na akong bigyan ka ng pangalawang pagkakataon. Naniniwala pa rin akong may mabuting tao sa loob mo.$s

records.source: Have I told you Haley and I are sisters? Strange, isn't it?
records.translation: Nasabi ko na ba sa iyo na magkapatid kami ni Haley? Kakaiba, hindi ba?

records.source: I have a secret hobby, but I won't say any more.#$e#Maybe I'll show you some day.$h
records.translation: May lihim akong libangan, pero wala na akong sasabihin.#$e#Baka ipakita ko sa iyo balang araw.$h

records.source: This world is full of spirits and magic... Some don't believe me, but I know it's true.#$e#I can see it in your eyes... you believe in the other world, like me.
records.translation: Punô ng mga espiritu at mahika ang mundong ito... May ilang hindi naniniwala sa akin, pero alam kong totoo iyon.#$e#Nakikita ko sa mga mata mo... naniniwala ka sa kabilang daigdig, tulad ko.

records.source: I wish Haley would get a job or at least contribute to cooking and cleaning.$s#$e#I think she's hoping to marry someone rich.$u
records.translation: Sana ay maghanap ng trabaho si Haley o kahit tumulong man lang sa pagluluto at paglilinis.$s#$e#Sa tingin ko'y umaasa siyang makapag-asawa ng mayaman.$u

records.source: I have to say, now that Haley's gone I've had a much easier time keeping things in order.
records.translation: Masasabi kong ngayong umalis na si Haley, mas madali kong napapanatiling maayos ang lahat.

records.source: There's good people in this town who just can't seem to find happiness. It makes me sad.$u#$e#Working in the saloon, I hear first-hand about everyone's problems.$u
records.translation: May mabubuting tao sa bayang ito na tila hindi matagpuan ang kaligayahan. Nalulungkot ako dahil doon.$u#$e#Sa pagtatrabaho ko sa saloon, naririnig ko mismo ang mga problema ng lahat.$u

records.source: I work part-time at Gus' saloon. It pays the bills.
records.translation: Hindi buong oras ang trabaho ko sa saloon ni Gus. Sapat iyon pambayad ng mga bayarin.

records.source: I'm just working at Gus' to make ends meet... but my real passion is tailoring.$u#$e#I made these clothes from scratch, see?
records.translation: Nagtatrabaho lang ako kay Gus upang matustusan ang mga gastusin... pero pananahi ang tunay kong hilig.$u#$e#Ako mismo ang gumawa ng mga damit na ito mula sa simula, kita mo?

records.source: Oh, hi... It's nice of you to visit me like this.$h
records.translation: Oh, kumusta... Napakabait mong dalawin ako nang ganito.$h

records.source: You know, @... I think the future looks bright for both of us.
records.translation: Alam mo, @... Sa tingin ko'y maliwanag ang hinaharap nating dalawa.

records.source: I've heard rumors of rare and powerful magic rings, forged long ago by forgotten civilizations. I'm not sure if it's true or just a fairy tale.
records.translation: May narinig akong mga sabi-sabi tungkol sa pambihira at makapangyarihang mga singsing na hinubog noong unang panahon ng mga kabihasnang nakalimutan na. Hindi ko tiyak kung totoo iyon o isang kuwentong engkanto lang.

records.source: You catch fish? I just hope you treat the poor things humanely.$s#$e#Every critter deserves our respect, even the slimy ones.
records.translation: Nanghuhuli ka ng isda? Sana lang ay makatao ang pagtrato mo sa mga kawawang nilalang.$s#$e#Karapat-dapat sa paggalang natin ang bawat nilalang, kahit ang madudulas na iyon.

records.source: Have faith... every day you're taking one more step on the path of your destiny.
records.translation: Manalig ka... bawat araw ay sumusulong ka ng isa pang hakbang sa landas ng kapalaran mo.
